correctness.rationale: All quantifiers include n≥1, b≠0 and arbitrary complex a. Exact autocorrelation coefficients C_{2n-j}=b conjugate(a_j) and the sole lag collision C_n=conjugate(a_0)z+b conjugate(z) reconstruct the first n coordinates. The remaining map has exact singular squares S+(|a0|±|b|)^2 by a two-real-dimensional phase extremum. Rank loss occurs exactly when S=0 and |a0|=|b|, and C0 fixes radius, yielding exactly the reflection pair. A 4n+1-grid inverts all Fourier modes by nonaliasing. Executable tests pass 2,185 parameter families, but the universal statements rest on this proof, not finite testing.

value.rationale: The motivating recent phase-retrieval background work distinguishes strict subcritical counterexamples from known supercritical uniqueness but does not settle this canonical single-spike discrete equality boundary. An all-complex, all-length classification of every exceptional fiber and the sharp two-dimensional stability spectrum identifies the precise obstruction caused by the unique colliding autocorrelation lag. It quantifies the useful placement/amplitude tradeoff for deterministic reference design, without claiming arbitrary backgrounds or a major general theorem.
